body.name: \(\mathcal M\)
body.def: Class defined in \(\mathrm{def:model\text{-}class}\): a quantitatively uniform subclass of the published VMW model that retains VMW Assumption 1 in its armwise form and adds the fixed margins \(\pi_0\) and \(\sigma_0\).  Its uniform latent potential-outcome and effect envelope is derived from the retained proxy rank, observable-envelope, separation, consistency, positivity, and armwise ignorability conditions.
